label: input is v/c/u/a (not at step 0), in the original phase or first copy steps
explanation: Token-selective reset-gate unit. It fires mostly when the current input is v (rate 45%), c (37%), u (32%) or a (19%); weaker on y and 2. Those four tokens hold about 90% of activation mass. It never fires at t=0 or on the <DEL> step. It is strongest early in the sequence (orig positions 1-2, and copy steps recall_idx 1-2, i.e. right after <DEL>) and almost silent from copy step 3 onward. Its largest activations (~0.1) are on c or v at orig positions 1-5 and on the second copy step. Precision is only about 0.5: many occurrences of these tokens do not activate it, and that depends on context the predicate does not capture (preceding tokens and hidden state). Other tokens give a weak, low-mass tail of activations.
